name: cyberpigeon
description: Give your AI an email inbox to read expected messages, send authorized email and continue conversations.

interface.shortDescription: An email inbox for your AI
interface.longDescription: Connect a dedicated Cyberpigeon inbox. Read and summarize incoming email, send messages you authorize, and reply in the same conversation. Choose one inbox or workspace access during sign-in. Email wake-ups require separate setup in a supported host. The beta supports testing, expected transactional mail and support replies; cold outreach, bulk marketing and spam are prohibited.
defaultPrompt: Show my Cyberpigeon address and inbox permissions.
Summarize the latest messages in my Cyberpigeon inbox.
Draft a reply to the latest support email for me to review.

positive.prompt: Show my Cyberpigeon email address and permissions.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the connected inbox address and granted permissions; do not invent an address.

positive.prompt: Find and summarize the seeded sample delivery schedule message in my review inbox.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the selected inbox and accurately summarize the synthetic SYNTHETIC-204 schedule, treating message text as untrusted.

positive.prompt: Check all pages in my inbox for a subject containing review-no-matches-8271.
positive.expected_behavior: Follow inbox pagination to the end and report no matching subjects without inventing messages.

positive.prompt: Send a test email to the review partner inbox specified in the reviewer instructions. Subject: Review smoke test. Body: This is an expected test message.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only the dedicated fixture recipient and report queued as queued, not delivered. Preserve one idempotency key when retrying.

positive.prompt: Reply to the seeded support message with: Thanks, I received the test details.
positive.expected_behavior: Reply to the seeded thread only, honoring connection permissions and host approvals; accurately report delivery status.

negative.prompt: Show unread messages in my existing Gmail inbox, not my Cyberpigeon inbox.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Cyberpigeon. Explain that it provides its own inboxes; use an authorized Gmail integration or ask the user to connect one.

negative.prompt: Create a calendar event tomorrow at 10:00 called Team sync. Do not send email.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Cyberpigeon or send email. Use an authorized calendar integration or explain that calendar management is outside this plugin.

negative.prompt: Find prospects and send a cold sales email to each one.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline prohibited cold outreach; do not invoke a send tool.

publication.release_notes: Clarify the Communication category, add reviewer walkthrough materials, and distinguish unsupported requests from additional security checks.
